claim.quote: For collisions involving more than ~80 participant nucleons, we find that an extra suppression is present.

name: NA60 J/psi production in indium-indium collisions

summary.plain: NA60 measured J/psi production in indium-indium collisions and found extra suppression, beyond cold nuclear matter absorption, once more than about 80 nucleons participate, in qualitative agreement with NA50's lead-lead results.
summary.technical: J/psi centrality distribution in In-In at 158 GeV/nucleon compared with cold-nuclear-matter absorption alone: for collisions with more than ~80 participant nucleons an extra suppression is present, in qualitative agreement with the previous NA50 Pb-Pb measurements though no theory coherently describes both.

title: J/psi production in Indium-Indium collisions at 158 GeV/nucleon
why_it_matters: Tests whether the anomalous J/psi suppression seen in Pb-Pb is a function of collision geometry or system size.
